Apple to Unveil Foldable iPhone and New Pro Models at Annual Event

Apple is set to launch its "Surprise and Shine" event on September 9, 2026, where it is expected to unveil the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max. The company is also anticipated to introduce its first foldable iPhone, potentially named iPhone Ultra. This event marks a departure from previous launches as Apple may skip the base iPhone 18 model. Alongside new iPhones, updates to the Apple Watch and AirPods are also expected. The event will begin at 10:30 PM IST and will be live-streamed. Some reports suggest the foldable iPhone could be priced over $2,000.
